question: How is reality revealed when covered by māyā?
premises: A condition covered by māyā prevails
The lamp of knowledge is applied
What is covered is seen and destroyed
inference: The lamp of knowledge reveals and destroys what is covered by māyā
uncertainties: The bracketed [hanyate] may be an editorial restoration
plain_english: Thus, when covered by māyā, it is seen by the lamp of knowledge and is destroyed.
